What is our Trade-In Program?

This program aims to give your pre-loved book(s) a new life when it is in hands of a new owner. Here, you can trade-in the book(s) that you have read OR the book(s) that you want to clear off your bookshelf. On top of that, you will be rewarded with Cash Points! (NOTE: Every book will be verified, cleaned and refurbished by Bookurve Team to ensure the book's quality).


Why trade-in your Pre-loved books?

1. To Create Sustainability: Re-used is always better than recycle.

2. Give Your Book(s) A Real New Life: We will refurbished your used book(s) so that other readers will read your used book(s) as a new book again.

3. You earn Cash Point: Purchase New book(s) AND Pre-Loved book(s) when paying with Cash points.

Check out our Pre-Loved book collection here. Stay tuned as more books are coming!


Join now by filling up our Google Form here. 👈👈👈

We will get back to you as soon as possible.


At this moment, we only ACCEPT selected fiction & non-fiction from:

  • English books (regularly sold on Bookurve website / preferably with minimum 100k ratings on Goodreads)
  • Malay books (with minimum 1k ratings on Goodreads / published by BUKU FIXI, ALAF 21, Buku Prima, etc.)
EXCEPT the following books which are ⚠️ NOT ACCEPTED ⚠️:
  • Academic / revision books / workbooks
  • Books without ISBN number
  • Books with missing pages / moldy / has spots or dirt inside the pages / torn up
  • Corporate books (e.g; management books, HR books etc.)
  • Comics
  • Fake books / photocopied books
  • Magazines
  • Chinese Books




FAQ:

1. How does Bookurve calculate the Cash Points for my book(s)?
"Cash Points" is determined by the BOOK CONDITION 📖 & the DEMAND from our readers (RM1 = 10 Cash Points).

📚For ENGLISH books:

a. Book with Very Good condition : 60 Cash Points ( worth RM6.00)

b. Book with Good condition : 30 Cash Points (worth RM3.00)

c. Book with Readable condition : 10 Cash Points ( worth RM1.00)

📚For MALAY books:

a. Book with Very Good condition : 40 Cash Points ( worth RM4.00)

b. Book with Good condition : 20 Cash Points (worth RM2.00)

c. Book with Readable condition : 10 Cash Points ( worth RM1.00)

2. How do I send my GoGreen Trade-In books to Bookurve?
There are TWO OPTIONS:

a) Via Bookurve’s GoGreen Logistic form.
Within 3-5 business days after you have filled in the GoGreen Enquiry form, our team will contact you for confirmation on the accepted books. During the contact, you will be provided with the GoGreen Logistic form where you may opt for drop off at courier's counter or pick up by the courier.

❗IMPORTANT NOTE❗: Bookurve will arrange the delivery for you whereby AT LEAST MINIMUM OF 3 BOOKS ACCEPTED.

b) Via self Drop Off at Bookurve’s office.
You may ship to / drop off the books at below address:
BOOKURVE, B2-01 (Ground Floor: Facing Subang Jaya LRT),
E-Tiara Serviced Apartment, Persiaran Kemajuan Subang,
47500 Subang Jaya, Selangor
h/p: +6016-445 4726

Operation hours:
Mon - Fri (excluding weekends & public holidays)
8.30am - 4.30pm

On your package/parcel, please include:
Subject: GOGREEN TRADE IN
Name:
Phone number:

We will determine the amount of your reward points (Cash points) and credit the points to your Bookurve account AFTER we have processed the books within 3-5 business days.

3. What Bookurve will do to my books if the books are not qualify?
For unqualified books, we will recycle them on your behalf.

4. Can I trade in back books that I purchased from Bookurve?
Yes, you can! Even if you bought the book(s) from other places. As long as your book condition is readable and adhere to our Quality Control standard with us.

5. How does Bookurve verify the used books' condition?
We will verify every books and we will categorise them into 4 types of condition.

Type 1: Very good condition
The book pages are in clean condition. It may contain: a line on the book cover, a slight dirt/mark. The book might not come with the book jacket.

Type 2: Good condition
The book pages are in clean condition. It may contain: small writing, a bit dirt, a bit damage at the book corner. The pages may turn yellow but does not contain mold/mildew.

Type 3: Readable
The book pages are in clean condition. It contains mold/mildew at the edge of the book pages.

Type 4: Rejected Book (Bookurve will recycle the books accordingly with no Cash Points rewards.)
The book contains: missing pages, too many handwriting & drawing, a lot of dirt and mildew.
